Container.Name: Unraid File Organizer
Container.Overview:
Smart, safe, self-hosted file organization for your Unraid server.
Unraid File Organizer scans the folders you allow, intelligently classifies every file — Windows installers, Android APKs, OS ISOs, media, archives, documents — and moves each one to a sensible destination like apps/windows/media/ or isos/windows/. Nothing moves without a preview, and every move can be undone.
FEATURES • Checkbox allow-list locations — unchecked folders are never scanned • Never-touch list; /boot, system shares and appdata are hard-forbidden • Smart classification incl. PE/APK binary analysis and ISO OS detection • Custom regex rules and per-category destination overrides • Dry-run by default with one-click undo • Optional local LLM assist (Ollama) for low-confidence files • Scheduled dry-run digests via Discord / ntfy / generic webhooks • Duplicate detection with journalled quarantine • Folder-level units: game/app directories move whole • Media library mode: Plex/Jellyfin-style TV & movie routing
GETTING STARTED Open the WebUI, add your messy folder under Allowed Locations, tick its checkbox, Scan, Build Plan, review, then Apply (keep Dry Run on until you trust it).
This container needs access to your shares: it mounts /mnt/user read-write.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port the organizer web interface listens on

Config.Name: User Shares
Config.Description: Unraid user share tree the organizer may scan and reorganize (restricted further by Allowed Locations in the UI)

Config.Name: Appdata Config
Config.Description: Persistent location for settings, operation journal, duplicate reports and scan history

Config.Name: Ollama URL
Config.Description: Optional default for LLM Assist — full URL of your Ollama server, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:11434. Leave blank to set it later in the web UI.
